meta.title: Milestone Progress Guard
meta.description: Persistently injects milestone reporting rules into the system prompt and adds soft-enforcement reminders when tool calls omit visible progress text.

enabled.title: Enable Plugin
enabled.description: Whether to enable persistent system prompt rules and post-tool-execution soft-enforcement reminders.

locale.title: Default Language Preset
locale.description: Language preset for built-in system prompt and reminder messages (zh / en).

sectionOrder.title: System Prompt Section Order
sectionOrder.description: Sort weight of the injected system prompt section (lower numbers appear earlier, default 180).

maxSilentSteps.title: Max Consecutive Silent Steps
maxSilentSteps.description: Number of consecutive silent tool-call steps allowed before injecting a reminder (default 0: remind immediately on the first silent step).

ignoreTools.title: Ignored Tools
ignoreTools.description: Tool names excluded from milestone progress reminders when invoked.

promptText.title: Custom System Prompt Section Text
promptText.description: Custom rules text injected into the system prompt (falls back to the built-in language preset when empty).

reminderText.title: Custom Reminder Text
reminderText.description: Custom notice text prepended to additionalContexts when a silent tool call is detected.
